fields.text: Filtered module-derivation anchor inputs in `RunOpsGC` to multi-segment non-dot paths (`strings.Contains(a, "/") && !strings.HasPrefix(a, ".")`) so root-level files (`Makefile`, `.gitignore`) and dot-directories (`.agents/...`, `.memory/...`) map cleanly to `"root"` without creating spurious `.agents` or `Makefile` module scopes during scope repair.
